description: This file contains functions and setup procedures for configuring, renewing, and tearing down DHCPv6 protocol in a network device, including initialization, prefix and send options management, and protocol registration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 configuration parameters with default values and options.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to a specified list.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration for a given interface, including options and environment exports.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Sends a signal to renew the DHCPv6 lease.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Kills the DHCPv6 process for the interface.
